Strip Teaser Band Lore: The creation of Strip Teaser was all Bailey Wilson ideas because music was a passion of hers. She slowly “recruited” (blackmailed really) Blake first, threatening to snitch on him for selling drugs and stealing from his job, to which Blake agreed even though he tries to leave everyday. 

The next person was Milo when she found out that he had connections to some pretty wealthy friends who could help push the band to new heights. Though, Milo does see what Bailey is doing as anything malicious, completely trusting her wholeheartedly. 

The last one to join was Gunnar, who met Bailey on the rooftop of their school where he was playing a song he had written for his younger stepsibling. She holds that knowledge over his head whenever he even mentions about leaving the group, threatening to tell his stepsibling about all the heinous acts he does while thinking about them.


Blake’s reason for leaving the band is that he hates the genre of music that make, enjoying more Dark Trap or Trap R&B. Unlike Gunnar, he doesn’t make his own music because he wants a career, but more as a hobby. What he enjoys most is the music he makes with his actual buddies, not the group of randos Bailey found. 

Secretly, Blake does like that the band has helped him with his own music, but would rather die than admit that aloud.
